connector.name: QuizBase
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for trivia: 1.4M+ questions (EN+PL), 24 categories, 12 tools + 4 prompts, OAuth 2.1.
connector.summary: Hosted at quizbase.runriva.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.runriva.quizbase, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <key>. Two auth modes supported. (1) API key — qb_pk_<random> (publishable, CORS-safe for browser/edge) or qb_sk_<random> (secret, server-only). Free tier 500 req/day; mint a key at https://quizbase.runriva.com/dashboard/keys. (2) OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591). Discovery: https://quizbase.runriva.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server. Use OAuth for end-user consent flows (Claude.ai Custom Connector default).
